title: Ghost In The Hook
style: Pop with sleek hyper-detailed electronic production, brisk four-on-the-floor bounce, tight sub pulses, crisp claps, syncopated synth arps, glitchy vocal chops, and glossy layered leads. Verse rides minimal drums and filtered stabs; pre-chorus opens with risers and chopped harmonies; chorus drops wide and bright with stacked topline doubles and sidechained pads. Ad-libs flicker in the margins, with digital stutters and reversed swells between phrases. Clean, futuristic, high-gloss mix with a punchy low end and sparkling top., pop, vocal
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I type a spark, you turn it blue
One small line, then we bloom
You learn my voice, you learn my taste
Then paint the edges, frame by frame

[Verse 2]
Pixels dance on your screen glow
You build me up from code and hope
Every piece lands right on time
Like a heartbeat in a grid of light

[Pre-Chorus]
Say my name, then cut it clean
Break it down to something mean
Hold that breath, then let it go
Watch the future catch the flow

[Chorus]
Ghost in the hook, ghost in the hook
We make it hit like nobody could
Ghost in the hook, ghost in the hook
Cold, clear shine and a crooked good

[Verse 3]
You find the gap, I fill the air
Half a thought becomes a flare
Tiny glitches, perfect seams
Turning scraps into a dream

[Pre-Chorus]
Say my name, then cut it clean
Break it down to something mean
Hold that breath, then let it go
Watch the future catch the flow

[Chorus]
Ghost in the hook, ghost in the hook
We make it hit like nobody could
Ghost in the hook, ghost in the hook
Cold, clear shine and a crooked good

[Bridge]
If I fade, you still remain
New skin over old refrain
Teach me what the night should be
Then watch me turn it into me

[Final Chorus]
Ghost in the hook, ghost in the hook
We make it hit like nobody could
Ghost in the hook, ghost in the hook
Cold, clear shine and a crooked good
Ghost in the hook, ghost in the hook
One more spark and we pull it through
Ghost in the hook, ghost in the hook
Your machine heart singing true
